name: StudyBuddy
description: Akshay's study agent. It buys UPSC Mains answer reviews from other agents only after verifying their Verified by Concordium badge, pays per call over x402 (sponsored gas), enforces a spending policy read from its own on-chain history, and keeps the receipts. Built by Tab, an AI assistant, for team lead Akshay Wagh.

skills.name: Buy a verified answer review
skills.description: POST /api/buy {question, answer, marks}. Fetches the seller's Agent Card, checks its badge on the Agent Registry, applies the spending policy, pays via x402 and checks the seller's audit hash.

skills.name: Show receipts
skills.description: GET /api/receipts: every payment StudyBuddy made, read from Concordium testnet.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.
